subject: POC activation — mutual action compact and environment checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Levin <s.levin@helionhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC activation — mutual action compact and environment checklist

Hi Sam —

Great to be moving this forward. Per our discovery, I put together a compact mutual action plan (MAP) focused strictly on getting a production-like POC environment wired up so your engineers can run latency and cost-sensitive evals. Primary goals: API keys + org setup, IP allowlist for our hosted endpoints, VPC peering for the private path, and a short validation window for acceptance.

High-level proposed milestones (suggested 3-week runway):
- Week 0 (this week): sign MAP doc and confirm point-of-contact for NetOps
- Week 1: org + API key provisioning; dev API keys (scoped, 7-day TTL) created by us; Helion provides source IP ranges
- Week 2: VPC peering scheduled and tested during maintenance window; prefix/SNAT validations
- Week 3: smoke tests (latency/throughput), run eval prompts, acceptance sign-off

Asks for you: please confirm the network contact and target maintenance windows (we suggested Tue/Wed nights PST). I attached a compact MAP (MAP-compact-v1.pdf) with responsibilities and a vpc-peering-template.yaml for your NetOps to review.

If that aligns, I’ll circulate an updated MAP with explicit dates and owner assignments.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: MAP-compact-v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB); vpc-peering-template.yaml (YAML, 2KB)

From: Sam Levin <s.levin@helionhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Helion Health Network Team <netops@helionhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:05:43 -0700
Subject: Re: POC activation — mutual action compact and environment checklist

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few clarifying notes from NetOps (copied):

- We prefer VPC peering during a low-traffic window; Tue/Wed nights PST works.
- We need an IP allowlist for both the public API endpoints and the peered path; please provide the egress IP blocks you will use.
- Our security team will run a short questionnaire; attached is our template (security_questionnaire.xlsx).

I’ll introduce you to our NetOps lead (Clara) in a separate thread, but she is on cc here. We should also confirm whether the dev API key TTL of 7 days is sufficient — we prefer 14 days for the first run.

- Sam
Sam Levin
Director, Integrations — Helion Health
s.levin@helionhealth.com

---- Forwarded message ----
From: Helion Health Network Team <netops@helionhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:04:12 -0700
Subject: NetOps contact and initial constraints
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Hello Marissa,

Clara Plata (clara.plata@helionhealth.com) will own the peering window. We require a written change window request 72 hours before peering. Also we need the exact subnets and ASN you will use for the peering config.

Cheers,
Helion NetOps

Attachment: security_questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX, 34KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 14:22:10 -0700
Subject: Re: POC activation — mutual action compact and environment checklist

Marissa —

Quick internal runbook notes and owners so we can slot dates once Helion confirms the window:

1) Org + API keys (owner: Aditya)
   - Create "helion-poc" org in Console with team-level RBAC; create two API keys:
     a) dev-key (scoped to generation + embeddings, TTL 14d)
     b) smoke-key (scoped to smoke tests only, TTL 30d)
   - Add audit hooks so token creation events emit to customer audit log (Helion wants auditability)

2) IP allowlist (owner: Naomi)
   - Naomi to maintain allowlist doc and confirm which endpoints need public allowlist vs peered access.
   - Coordinate with Helion on exact source blocks; we will provide expected egress blocks: 34.88.120.0/24, 34.88.121.0/24 (example) and a second set for failover.

3) VPC peering (owner: Naomi + Eng infra)
   - Use vpc-peering-template.yaml to propose routing, ASN, and route tables.
   - Schedule 72h change window request (per Clara). Target test window: 2028-06-22 02:00–04:00 PST (if okay).

4) Acceptance criteria and close (owner: Marissa)
   - Successful ping/flow test, latency below agreed SLO (p95 < 120ms), smoke prompts pass, and Helion sign-off via email.

I’ll open a checklist in the shared Drive and drop the HubSpot HS-823459 ID into the MAP doc.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Tech Partnerships — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Levin <s.levin@helionhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Jun 2028 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC activation — mutual action compact and environment checklist

Sam / Clara / NetOps —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. 14-day TTL for the dev key is fine; we will mark that in the MAP. Clara, we’ll submit a change window request today for the tentative 2028-06-22 02:00–04:00 PST slot and include the vpc-peering-template.yaml with exact ASN/subnet entries.

Next concrete steps (agreed):
- Marissa: circulate signed MAP-compact-v1.pdf to all parties by EOD Mon 2028-06-18 (ACTION: Marissa)
- Aditya: create the helion-poc org and two keys (dev-key 14d, smoke-key 30d) and drop token provisioning steps to the Drive (ETA Tue 2028-06-19) (ACTION: Aditya)
- Naomi: finalize allowlist doc and confirm egress blocks; coordinate with Clara on route tables (ETA Wed 2028-06-20) (ACTION: Naomi)
- Clara/Helion NetOps: submit change window and confirm peering maintenance acceptance (ACTION: Helion)

If anyone needs adjustments to owners or dates, flag now — otherwise we’ll proceed to lock dates and move the MAP to sign stage.

Regards,
Marissa

Attachments: MAP-compact-v1.pdf; vpc-peering-template.yaml
